author: Aakanksha Janday
review: Good tasty food. Reasonable for everyday office people. - Do try Veg tadka maggi.

author: Vikas Kundaliya
review: One of the Best Places ever visited in Vadodara for having a bite full of authenticity.

author: Brijesh Ahir
review: Delicious food with reasonable price 🤤😋Must visit once 🤌🏻 Owner behaviour is very friendly, I try Poha and thepla it was very tasty 😋 He also make good tea ☕

author: Meera Patel
review: Booked Brahmani Catering for a family housewarming event. The menu selection was incredible and our guests couldn't stop praising the Gujurati Thali items. Pure perfection!

author: Rohan Shah
review: My go-to spot for an evening chill. Their thick shakes are easily the best in Subhanpura. Fast service and a really cool vibe.
